explication: Herdr is a terminal-based runtime for coding-agent sessions: a client attaches to a background server, which owns terminal panes and presents their state and layout. Users interact through the terminal UI or CLI/socket API; agents can also issue API commands. The graph preserves the documented branches for session recovery, remote machines, agent detection, plugins, integrations, and workspace/worktree management. Source excerpts are partial, so links for unsampled internals are included only where the README or SOURCE INDEX supports them.
